review.posthog_relevance: Adds account-not-found error handling and test coverage for warehouse credential validation, potentially distinguishing account errors from credential errors.
review.reason: P1.F1.H1 adds a 404 status check and account-not-found error message; P1.F2.H1 adds a corresponding test. This is a localized, bounded correctness and reliability improvement.
